core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muslih corresponds to the Arabic form مُصْلِح (Arabic root ص ل ح (ṣ-l-ḥ); مُصْلِح (Muṣliḥ)). Its core sense is muslih; reformer, one who sets things right. Muslih is Arabic مُصْلِح (Muṣliḥ) 'reformer, one who sets things right', from the root ص ل ح (ṣ-l-ḥ). The source gloss 'Bringing Peace' is broadly consistent. Same name as musleh.
